body.title: The registry row carries the last full index's figures (lastRun)
body.summary: RepoLastRun type and optional lastRun on RepoRow (src/db/graph/codec.ts) and RegisteredRepo (src/shared/types.ts); encodeRepoRow writes it, decodeRepoRow copies it explicitly; updateRepoStatus (src/db/repos.ts) takes an optional lastRun argument and keeps the stored one when omitted; rowToRepo maps it. Grounding: RepoRow at src/db/graph/codec.ts:89, encodeRepoRow :105 and decodeRepoRow :114-127 (a const arrow that builds the row field by field, so lastRun must be copied explicitly); updateRepoStatus src/db/repos.ts:243, rowToRepo :340; RegisteredRepo src/shared/types.ts:678. decodeRepoRow copies lastRun only when present (...(raw.lastRun !== undefined ? { lastRun: raw.lastRun } : {})), so the strict round-trip tests in src/db/graph/__tests__/codec.test.ts (:40, :50) still hold for a row without it.
acceptanceChecks: A row with lastRun round-trips through the codec; an older row decodes with lastRun undefined.
A status write without lastRun keeps the stored lastRun; a write with it replaces it; rowToRepo exposes it.
